algorithm.name: CRU-Harness LongBench multiview raw-evidence controller with option verification

benchmark.name: LongBench v2
benchmark.upstream_revision_limitation: The original local HF rows cache did not record a revision
benchmark.source_selection: Keep mandatory eight; add nearest two below and nearest two above the 1050000-token native admission boundary, from remaining candidates, using exact Sol counts plus 1024 output reserve; tie by index; source hashes unique

budgets.capacity_probe: One explicitly submitted above-native request per model with a separate enlarged submission ceiling

transport_encoding.interpretation: Lossless wire encoding only; not model-context expansion

metric_definitions.task_success: A parseable final A/B/C/D equals the frozen reference letter; failure or missing output is unsuccessful
metric_definitions.native_direct_primary: Correct task delivery among sources within published native admission, retaining provider context rejections, infrastructure failures, and missing outputs; not pure semantic accuracy
metric_definitions.native_direct_all12: Operational task success over all 12, with admission-denied cases separately labeled, not wrong semantic answers
metric_definitions.harness_primary: Correct final choice over all 12 sources, including errors and missing outputs
metric_definitions.paired_primary: Matched native-admissible sources, retaining failures on either arm
metric_definitions.paired_available_secondary: Conditional on both arms returning an answer; not the primary comparison
metric_definitions.capacity_probe: Separate API capacity/transport outcome; never receives a semantic score
metric_definitions.length: Responses input-envelope counts; full admission includes budget notice and 16 safety tokens, unlike raw-text tokenization
metric_definitions.coverage: Bounded evidence retrieval does not imply every source token was read by the model

above_native_harness.definition: Actual native-Direct full-prompt admission input plus 1024 output exceeds 1050000

observed_capacity.unit: Exact complete native-Direct prompt admission, including formatting and safety margin

registered_zero_generation_recovery.eligibility: terminal generic-network error; ledger empty; physical requests=0; charged tokens=0; no outstanding reservation
registered_zero_generation_recovery.count_attempt_metric: Physical count requests include all original misses and recovery retry attempts; cache hits and logical queries are separately counted

cost.definition: Conservative generation estimate, not invoice. Separate input max ordinary/read/default-30m write price and output price; input >272000 applies whole-request 2x input / 1.5x output. Unknown delivery retains the reservation.
cost.admission: (admitted input * max(ordinary,cached,default-30m write) + reserved output * output rate) / 1e6
cost.long_input: Above 272000 admitted input: whole-request input/cache rates x2 and output rate x1.5
cost.known_usage: Actual input/output settled at admitted envelope rates
cost.unknown_usage: Full monetary and token reservations retained; not known actual token usage or an invoice

limitations: Previously consumed LongBench regression sources; no claim of a new blind holdout or unknown pretraining exposure
12 length-biased sources across six domains; not a full 503 score or an official leaderboard submission
Different native-Direct and bounded-Harness compute ceilings; this is not a same-compute accuracy comparison
One model run per source/arm; 72 main records are not 72 independent sources
Distinct source IDs and hashes do not exclude underlying record overlap; intervals are descriptive context-unit summaries
Maximum attempted, answered, and correct sizes are different observations, not a proven absolute context limit
The model attention window is unchanged; observed extension is system-level task execution over external sources
Long ordered text parts repair a transport field limit without removing provider context limits
The LongBench evidence route differs from the V3.2 OOLONG structured-fact path
Provider-rejected probes can lack usage; retained reservations are conservative accounting, not known incurred tokens
Published-window admission and actual provider acceptance can disagree; actual HTTP context rejections are reported separately
The first trial had 39 zero-generation count-network failures; original partial outcomes are preserved separately from the registered recovery overlay
Recovery changed count-only retry orchestration, not source selection, evidence controller, or model generation policies
The head/tail quality control uses only the fixed longest one or two sources and a larger 800k prompt budget; its small-sample scores are not pooled into the main 12-source comparison

Full trajectory replay is unavailable for 39 preserved original zero-generation failures and Sol Harness index 251 because the original count exception payload was not recorded; all 120 token/money ledgers pass, but unavailable trajectories are not marked passed

Strict raw-reply parsing is a retrospective diagnostic on 46 traceable replies; the one missing Harness raw replay is unavailable, not a format failure, and primary controller-choice results remain unchanged

headtail_quality_control.selection_rule: Money only: remaining >=13 selects 143+260; >=6.5 selects 143; otherwise explicit budget skip
headtail_quality_control.compatible_primary_parser: Local compatible A/B/C/D extraction, same as the main controller
headtail_quality_control.strict_secondary_parser: Actual head/tail response with stars removed, then the two capitalized The correct answer is patterns; bare A alone is not accepted

strict_selected_raw_reply_diagnostic.scope: Post-hoc exact-pattern extraction from the original fixed selected raw reply; not an official leaderboard score or a replacement for controller-choice accuracy
